key.mobtalk.gift: Give one item from your hand to the chosen mob
mobtalk.settings.title: Mob Talk — control panel
mobtalk.settings.test.tooltip: Hold the talk key on the test screen. The test uses only local Whisper.
mobtalk.settings.sttPath.tooltip: Auto uses your own Whisper when installed, otherwise the server. The server recognizes the recording with an OpenRouter model (when the server allows it). Text only: no microphone, type in chat.
mobtalk.settings.whisper.url.tooltip: Only http://127.0.0.1:port or http://localhost:port. Model, language and device apply when a new helper starts.
mobtalk.settings.save.failed: Could not save settings. Please retry.
mobtalk.settings.list.empty: No microphones found. Check Windows microphone access.
mobtalk.settings.list.failed: Could not list microphones. Check Windows microphone access.
mobtalk.test.title: Microphone Test
mobtalk.test.instructions: Hold %s and speak (up to %s sec.), then release. Local Whisper recognizes your speech.
mobtalk.test.ready: Ready to test. Recording has not started.
mobtalk.test.too_short: Recording too short. Hold %s and say a phrase.
mobtalk.test.no_speech: No speech recognized. Hold %s and retry.
mobtalk.test.success: Microphone and Whisper work. Hold %s to test again.
mobtalk.test.microphone_busy: Microphone is finishing a recording or unavailable. Release the key and retry.
mobtalk.test.focus_lost: Test cancelled: window lost focus. Release the key and retry.
mobtalk.test.failed: Could not test microphone. Check Windows access and local Whisper.
mobtalk.test.scroll.tooltip: Scroll the transcript (mouse wheel also works).
mobtalk.settings.tab.general.full: On/off, vision, HUD line, how mobs call you, keys
mobtalk.settings.reset.draft: Defaults restored in the draft. Save to apply.
mobtalk.settings.reset.tooltip: Restore default preferences in the draft. Cancel before saving to discard.
mobtalk.settings.rudeness.tooltip: How rude and profane mobs are. Angry and rude characters swear more than kind ones.
mobtalk.settings.microphone.cycle: Click for next device; Shift for previous.
mobtalk.settings.search: Find a species by name or ID
mobtalk.settings.find.tooltip: Looks through names and tooltips on the tabs from General to Actions at once. Species and the selected mob are not included. Switch tabs to leave the search.
mobtalk.settings.group.toggle: Click to show or hide the group's sliders. The group's switches always stay visible.
mobtalk.settings.species.tooltip: %s (%s). Click to cycle; Shift to go back.
mobtalk.settings.archetype.label: Archetype
mobtalk.settings.voice.id.tooltip: Blank keeps the library assignment. Existing individual voices are edited in the mob profile.
mobtalk.settings.voice.preview.tooltip: Play existing ElevenLabs library audio. This does not test OpenRouter generation.
mobtalk.settings.voice.test.tooltip: Generate a short phrase through OpenRouter Flash v2.5 using your account credits.
mobtalk.settings.voice.phrase: Hello! I can speak calmly or expressively, notice important details and answer your questions. Let's check how clearly this voice sounds.
mobtalk.settings.mob.empty: Aim at a living mob and press V first.
mobtalk.settings.mob.loadFailed: Could not load the profile. Select the mob again.
mobtalk.settings.mob.name: Conversation name
mobtalk.settings.mob.clearPending: Exchanges will be cleared when saved. Edit memory separately.
mobtalk.settings.mob.request.tooltip: The LLM considers this request using personality, attitude and current context.
mobtalk.settings.operation.failed: Action failed. Refresh the profile and retry.
mobtalk.friend.stay.start: %s stays here and waits; release it with STOP or the cancel button
mobtalk.friend.guard.player: %s guards you; release it with STOP or the cancel button
mobtalk.friend.guard.here: %s guards this place; release it with STOP or the cancel button
mobtalk.friend.spare.label: leave %s alone
mobtalk.editor.count: %s / %s characters · Changes stay in the draft
mobtalk.editor.readonly: Read only · Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C to copy
mobtalk.test.play.failed: Could not play the recording. Check Windows output device.
mobtalk.test.compare.tooltip: Reuse one saved WAV for all selected models sequentially. Missing models will download; only one model is loaded at a time.
mobtalk.test.compare.running: Starting comparison with the same recording…
mobtalk.test.compare.done: Models finished: %s. Open results and choose one.
mobtalk.test.results.empty: No results yet. Hold the talk key on the Record tab.
mobtalk.settings.mob.resetPersonality.to: Rerolls temperament and personal traits after Save. Keeps voice, memory, history and relationships.
mobtalk.settings.mob.resetPending: Individuality will be rerolled after Save.
mobtalk.settings.mob.memoryPending: Memory summary will be cleared after Save. History and relationships are kept.
mobtalk.settings.connection.tooltip: Checks access and keys: the selected reply provider and OpenRouter for speech. Does not run a paid LLM or speech.
mobtalk.settings.tab.species.full: Character and voice of every species and its three archetypes
mobtalk.settings.key.paste.tooltip: Paste the key from the clipboard (or Ctrl+V in the field). The key is shown as asterisks.
mobtalk.settings.key.empty: Paste a key into the field first.
mobtalk.settings.key.failed: Could not save the OpenRouter key.
mobtalk.settings.key.hint: Windows encrypts the keys for your account; they never go into mobtalk.json.
mobtalk.settings.microphone.label: Microphone
mobtalk.settings.provider.tooltip: Who writes the mobs' replies. The speech provider is chosen separately below.
mobtalk.settings.provider.veniceModels: Venice models, e.g. deepseek-v4-1-flash, venice-uncensored-1-2, claude-haiku-5-5
mobtalk.settings.key.remove.tooltip.open: Removes the key saved from this menu or in config/mobtalk-openrouter-token.txt. OPENROUTER_API_KEY is not changed.
mobtalk.settings.key.remove.tooltip.veni: Removes the key saved from this menu or in config/mobtalk-venice-token.txt. VENICE_API_KEY is not changed.
mobtalk.settings.key.environment.openrou: Using OPENROUTER_API_KEY (%s); the variable overrides the menu key.
mobtalk.settings.key.environment.venice: Using VENICE_API_KEY (%s); the variable overrides the menu key.
mobtalk.settings.key.none.openrouter: No key yet. Paste your OpenRouter key below.
mobtalk.settings.key.none.venice: No key yet. Paste your Venice key below.
mobtalk.settings.tts.tooltip: Who voices the replies. OpenRouter: ElevenLabs voices by id from the species catalog. Venice: tts-elevenlabs-turbo-v2-5 uses the same voice ids, other Venice models use one voice for every mob.
mobtalk.settings.tts.veniceNote: Venice: tts-elevenlabs-turbo-v2-5 keeps the per-mob ElevenLabs voice ids (the Venice voice field is then unused); tts-kokoro and others use one voice for all (af_sky, af_bella, am_adam…), none of them Russian.
mobtalk.settings.stateHud: Mob's state in the Mob Talk line
mobtalk.settings.nameTags: Name, state and relationship over known mobs
mobtalk.settings.keepAcquainted.tooltip: A creature you talked to, gave to or helped is marked persistent and never despawns, like a name-tagged one.
mobtalk.settings.vision: Vision: a screenshot with the question
mobtalk.settings.vision.tooltip: A shot of what you see goes to the model with the question (~300 tokens, +0.3–1 s). "When there is a reason": a first meeting, a request to look, or an odd place (pit, chamber, cage). The place facts outrank the picture.
mobtalk.settings.social: Mobs act on their relations with each other
mobtalk.settings.socialLayer.tooltip: Characters, gestures (joke, compliment, hug, flirt, kiss), gifts, hearts, marriage, children and village standing. Villagers only.
mobtalk.settings.playerGender.tooltip: For courtship and marriage with villagers: a villager agrees only if drawn to your gender. "Not counted" skips the check.
mobtalk.settings.familyLife.tooltip: Villagers marry each other, children are born only to couples (villager+villager, you+spouse) and grow longer than vanilla's 20 minutes. While on, vanilla villager breeding is off.
mobtalk.family.wedding: [Mob Talk] A wedding in the village: %s and %s
mobtalk.village.noTrade: The village exiled you: villagers will not trade with you
mobtalk.settings.coSleep.tooltip: When you lie down in a bed, a villager dating or married to you lies down in a free bed within 2 blocks, or in yours, in the ordinary vanilla sleeping pose. Ask "пойдём спать" and the partner follows you to bed. Nothing beyond vanilla sleep.
mobtalk.settings.decider.tooltip: Rules: deterministic, no requests. Jev: a small decision model on the OpenRouter key (~$0.0001 per decision, under a second); the rules answer on failure.
mobtalk.settings.bargainHud: Haggling progress in the Mob Talk line
mobtalk.settings.tab.model.full: Reply provider and model, reasoning, background model, decider, keys
mobtalk.settings.tab.talk.full: Reply length and rudeness, bystanders, mob state, memory
mobtalk.settings.tab.social.full: Families, gifts, hearts, mob bonds, rumours, initiative, village standing
mobtalk.settings.tab.actions.full: Stay and guard requests, trade and place analysis
mobtalk.settings.enabled.tooltip: Master switch: without it mobs neither listen nor answer and their social life stops.
mobtalk.settings.stateHud.tooltip: One word about the selected mob's feelings in the Mob Talk line.
mobtalk.settings.bargainHud.tooltip: While haggling, the Mob Talk line shows whether the mob leans towards a concession.
mobtalk.settings.names.hint: Comma-separated names, up to 10 per list and 30 characters each. Empty means your Minecraft nick.
mobtalk.settings.names.neutral.tooltip: The first name is the one everybody knows you by: facts, memory, witnesses, rumours. The rest are ordinary forms of address.
mobtalk.settings.names.close.tooltip: Used by mobs whose relationship reaches the friend heart (40 by default). Empty uses the ordinary names.
mobtalk.settings.names.hostile.tooltip: Used by mobs with a relationship of −20 or below. Empty uses the ordinary names.
mobtalk.settings.keys.commands: /mobtalk info — mob and village, /mobtalk state — state, /mobtalk say <text> — type a line
mobtalk.settings.llm.tooltip: Model id at the selected provider, e.g. openai/gpt-6-luna.
mobtalk.settings.reasoning.tooltip: OpenRouter reasoning models think before answering. "None" saves 1.5–2.5 s per reply; "minimal" still thinks on most replies; "default" leaves it to the provider.
mobtalk.settings.backgroundModel.tooltip: A cheap model for work nobody waits for: conversation summaries, reflections, rumours.
mobtalk.settings.commonPrompt.tooltip: A common addition to every mob's character: manner, limits, tone. Not reset by the section button.
mobtalk.settings.social.tooltip: Mobs act on how they feel about each other: friends drift together, enemies apart, a friend visits a mourner.
mobtalk.settings.initiative.tooltip: Creatures speak first on an occasion: your return, an open deal, a friend nearby, building, weather.
mobtalk.settings.giftsFirst.tooltip: A reaction to a gift or a family event goes ahead of bystanders and small talk, and several gifts in a row to one creature get one reaction, not a queue.
mobtalk.settings.placeAnalysis.tooltip: The mob understands where it stands: walled in or not, exits, height, objects around.
mobtalk.settings.placeClassifier.tooltip: A small classifier names the place (mine, house, cave); tens of milliseconds off the game thread.
mobtalk.settings.place.note: The radius and flood-fill limits of the place analysis are fixed for now.
mobtalk.settings.tts.keyNote: Provider keys are entered on the Model tab.
mobtalk.settings.resetSection.tooltip: This tab's numbers and switches return to defaults in the draft. Texts, microphone, names and keys stay. Cancel to undo.
mobtalk.settings.resetSection.done: Tab reset in the draft. Press Save to apply.
mobtalk.settings.villageSites.tooltip: A villager belongs to the village whose buildings hold its bell or home (vanilla, or a village mod such as CTOV). Two neighbouring villages do not merge and a large one does not split. Off: the nearest known village within 160 blocks, as before.
mobtalk.settings.villageChatter.tooltip: Two villagers of one village standing together sometimes trade 2–3 voiced lines while you are near: rumours, weather, work, your fame. It introduces them and passes a rumour on. Cheap background model.
mobtalk.settings.villageNotices.tooltip: Villagers you know sometimes write to the chat in their own name: village news or "come over, I have work". Go to the one who called and get a favour with a reward.
mobtalk.tune.maxDistance.tooltip: How far from a mob you may stand to talk to it. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.maxReplyWords.tooltip: How many words a mob may say in one line. Longer means slower speech and costlier requests.
mobtalk.tune.maxRecordingSeconds.tooltip: How long one hold of the talk key may record. 15 seconds at most.
mobtalk.tune.voiceFullRange: Voice at full strength within %s blocks
mobtalk.tune.voiceFullRange.tooltip: Closer than this a mob's voice is at full strength; farther it fades smoothly. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.voiceSilentRange.tooltip: At this distance a mob's voice is gone; it fades smoothly up to it, never cut off. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.voiceGraceSeconds: Out of sight: holds for %s s
mobtalk.tune.voiceGraceSeconds.tooltip: How many seconds a mob that briefly lost sight or reach of you (a tree, a corner) keeps watching you and keeps the conversation and its line.
mobtalk.tune.whisperBeamSize.tooltip: How many hypotheses Whisper keeps. Higher is more accurate but slower. Applies after Whisper restarts.
mobtalk.tune.whisperVadSilenceMs.tooltip: Silence after which Whisper ends a phrase. Milliseconds.
mobtalk.tune.whisperCpuThreads.tooltip: CPU threads Whisper uses without a GPU.
mobtalk.tune.requestTimeoutSeconds.toolt: Seconds to wait for the model or speech before giving up.
mobtalk.tune.firstTokenSeconds.tooltip: Seconds to wait for the model's first token; a stalled request is cancelled and sent once more. 0 waits the whole request timeout.
mobtalk.tune.witnessReplies.tooltip: How many bystanders may add a line after the mob you talk to (0–2).
mobtalk.tune.witnessHearingRange.tooltip: Within this radius mobs hear the player's insults and threats and may chip in. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.witnessSightRange.tooltip: Within this radius mobs notice the player's blows, kills and misdeeds. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.witnessCooldownSeconds: A witness counts a deed once per %s s
mobtalk.tune.witnessCooldownSeconds.tool: Within this time repeated blows seen by one mob do not add up (a kill after blows still counts). Seconds.
mobtalk.tune.witnessHitPenalty.tooltip: How much a mob that saw the player hit another creature likes the player less.
mobtalk.tune.witnessKillPenalty.tooltip: Relationship drop for a mob that saw a kill. Monsters and attackers can be fought freely.
mobtalk.tune.witnessInsultPenalty.toolti: Relationship drop for a bystander who heard the player insult a mob.
mobtalk.tune.witnessThreatPenalty.toolti: Relationship drop for a bystander who heard a death threat.
mobtalk.tune.smallTalkChance: Chance to chip in without cause: %s%%
mobtalk.tune.smallTalkChance.tooltip: The chance a bystander adds a line with no special occasion (rule decider). Percent.
mobtalk.tune.stateHalfLifeMinutes.toolti: Half-life of mood, calm, interest and trust after ordinary events. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.stateSlowHalfLifeMinutes.to: Half-life after a blow, a kill, a threat or a big favour. Not below the ordinary one. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.waryCalm.tooltip: Below this calm (0–100) a mob makes no concessions and no deals.
mobtalk.tune.waryTrust.tooltip: Below this trust (0–100) a mob makes no concessions or deals; it speaks up less too.
mobtalk.tune.keenInterest.tooltip: From this interest (0–100) an acquainted mob turns to an approaching player.
mobtalk.tune.generousMood.tooltip: Together with trust above its threshold the mob haggles more generously. 0–100.
mobtalk.tune.generousTrust.tooltip: Together with mood above its threshold the mob haggles more generously. 0–100.
mobtalk.tune.historyTurns.tooltip: How many recent exchanges go to the model. More remembers better, costs more.
mobtalk.tune.maxMemoryChars.tooltip: Limit of a mob's long-term memory text (facts about you). Characters.
mobtalk.tune.memoryHalfLifeDays: Facts fade by half in %s days
mobtalk.tune.memoryHalfLifeDays.tooltip: How fast old facts give way to new ones when memory is full. Real days.
mobtalk.tune.memoryFloorPercent.tooltip: The floor of a fact's freshness: a month-old blow still outweighs yesterday's small talk. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.memoryMaxFacts.tooltip: How many separate facts a mob keeps about the world and the player.
mobtalk.tune.conversationSilenceMinutes: Conversation ends after %s min of silence
After this pause the conversation is summarised. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.reflectionReplies.tooltip: How many replies pass before a mob draws conclusions about the player.
mobtalk.tune.reflectionImportance.toolti: Total importance of events since last time needed for a reflection.
mobtalk.tune.reflectionCooldownSeconds.t: Minimum pause between one mob's reflections. Seconds.
mobtalk.tune.weddingChance.tooltip: Chance each minute that a village near you holds a wedding. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.birthChance.tooltip: Chance each minute that a married villager couple has a child. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.childGrowthDays: Child grows up in %s game days
mobtalk.tune.childGrowthDays.tooltip: Game days for a child to pass four stages to adulthood.
mobtalk.tune.foodGiftHearts.tooltip: Relationship from an animal's first favourite food; each repeat gives 2 less.
mobtalk.tune.giftSaturationPercent.toolt: How fast identical gifts get boring. 0 means never. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.giftHeartsPercent.tooltip: Share of a gift's value that turns into relationship. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.gestureFatigueMinutes.toolt: How fast a villager recovers from jokes, hugs and flirting. Minutes per point.
mobtalk.tune.giftForgetMinutes.tooltip: Every this many minutes a villager forgets the oldest gift and enjoys it again. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.heartsFriend.tooltip: From this relationship a villager counts you a friend and mobs use your close names.
mobtalk.tune.heartsDating.tooltip: From this relationship a villager accepts a bouquet. Not below the friend step.
mobtalk.tune.heartsMarriage.tooltip: From this relationship a villager accepts a ring; children with you need it too.
mobtalk.tune.jealousyTalk.tooltip: Jealousy a partner gets when you talk to another villager of its sex (once per 2 min per rival).
mobtalk.tune.jealousySleep.tooltip: Jealousy when you sleep within 3 blocks of another villager of the partner's sex.
mobtalk.tune.jealousyFavor.tooltip: Jealousy when you complete a favour for another villager of the partner's sex.
mobtalk.tune.jealousyGift.tooltip: Base jealousy for a gift to another villager of the partner's sex; each heart the gift was worth adds two more.
mobtalk.tune.jealousyRumorPercent.toolti: How strong a cause is when the partner did not see it but lives in the rival's village. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.jealousyMarriedPercent.tool: A spouse is more jealous than a sweetheart. Percent of the base.
mobtalk.tune.jealousyHeartsPercent.toolt: What share of each jealousy rise comes off the relationship. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.jealousyHalfLifeMinutes.too: Half of the jealousy is gone after this many minutes of real time.
mobtalk.tune.jealousyAttention.tooltip: How much a conversation with the jealous partner soothes it; gifts and a night together soothe more.
mobtalk.tune.coSleepRange.tooltip: A partner this close walks over and lies down when you sleep. Twice as far when invited with «пойдём спать».
mobtalk.tune.coSleepNightDelay: Night with partner: skip after %s s
mobtalk.tune.coSleepNightDelay.tooltip: While a partner is coming to bed or lying beside you, the night is skipped after this many seconds instead of vanilla 5, so you can talk in bed (hold V with an empty chat line). 0 means vanilla.
mobtalk.settings.rivals.tooltip: When two or more players court one villager, it knows, compares you and picks the best before the engagement, not whoever brought flowers first. The engagement closes the heart. Off: the first bouquet takes the villager, as before.
mobtalk.settings.rivalSteal: A partner can be won over
mobtalk.settings.rivalSteal.tooltip: The villager leaves its partner for another player who is clearly dearer (by "Win over: +N") and comes with flowers. Only before the engagement.
mobtalk.settings.rivalTrials.tooltip: Once a game day the villager sets all suitors one task: who brings an item first or pleases it with a gift. The winner gets hearts and a bonus to the choice.
mobtalk.settings.rivalBellScene.tooltip: A ring with a strong rival around: the villager calls all suitors to the bell and names its choice before the village. Off: it decides on the spot.
mobtalk.settings.rivalHud.tooltip: Looking at a villager you court with rivals around: the hotbar line shows the leading rival and whether they are ahead, even or behind you.
mobtalk.tune.rivalWindowHours.tooltip: How many hours of real time a player stays a suitor after the last flirt, kiss, flowers or ring.
mobtalk.tune.rivalMaxSuitors.tooltip: How many players a villager counts as suitors at once; the rest it ignores.
mobtalk.tune.rivalStealMargin.tooltip: How much dearer a player must be than the villager's partner for it to leave. A flirty one needs 10 less, a sensitive or unflappable one 10 more.
mobtalk.tune.rivalTrialWin.tooltip: Hearts for whoever completes the villager's trial first.
mobtalk.tune.rivalTrialTry.tooltip: Hearts for those who tried too but were late.
mobtalk.tune.rivalStrong.tooltip: From these hearts a rival stands in the way of a ring: the villager does not answer at once but chooses between you.
mobtalk.tune.rivalGatherMinutes.tooltip: How long the villager waits for its suitors at the bell; then it chooses among those who came.
mobtalk.tune.rivalLoserPenalty.tooltip: Hearts the one not chosen loses. 0 means no penalty.
mobtalk.tune.rivalLoserPauseHours.toolti: How many hours the villager takes no flowers or ring from the loser.
mobtalk.tune.coSleepHearts.tooltip: Relationship a night spent beside the partner adds (once per night); trust rises too.
mobtalk.tune.socialActionsPerMinute.tool: How many walks to friends and away from enemies per minute in a world.
mobtalk.tune.socialPlayerRange.tooltip: Beyond this distance from the player no social life happens. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.socialApproachChance: Chance to walk to a friend: %s%%
mobtalk.tune.socialApproachChance.toolti: Chance per check (every 2 s) that a mob walks to a friend in sight. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.socialApproachMin: Walks to a friend beyond %s blocks
mobtalk.tune.socialApproachMin.tooltip: Closer than this the friend is already near. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.socialApproachMax.tooltip: Further than this the friend is too far to walk to. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.socialRetreatRange: Steps away from a rival within %s blocks
mobtalk.tune.socialRetreatRange.tooltip: A rival closer than this makes the mob step away. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.bondHalfLifeHours: Bonds between mobs halve in %s h
mobtalk.tune.bondHalfLifeHours.tooltip: How fast mob friendships and feuds fade without meetings. Real hours.
mobtalk.tune.griefMinutes.tooltip: How long a mob mourns a dead friend or relative. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.rumorForgetDays.tooltip: A rumour weighs less each day and is gone after this many game days.
mobtalk.tune.rumorsPerVillage.tooltip: How many rumours a village keeps at once.
mobtalk.tune.rumorsPerVillager.tooltip: How many rumours one villager knows.
mobtalk.tune.rumorSpreadPercent.tooltip: Base chance a rumour passes between villagers who meet (weightier and closer ones more often). Percent.
mobtalk.tune.rumorsInPrompt.tooltip: How many of the weightiest rumours a villager has in mind while talking.
mobtalk.tune.rumorChronicleImportance.to: Importance of new events after which the village chronicle is written before the day is out.
mobtalk.tune.initiativesPerMinute.toolti: How often per minute creatures may speak first in the world.
mobtalk.tune.initiativeMobCooldownMinute: One mob speaks first once per %s min
Pause between one creature's initiatives. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.initiativeReturnMinutes.too: Absence after which an acquaintance greets your return. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.initiativeSpeakRange.toolti: Distance from which a mob calls out to the player. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.initiativeHearRange: You hear initiatives up to %s blocks
mobtalk.tune.initiativeHearRange.tooltip: Beyond this the player would not hear, so the mob keeps quiet. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.initiativeMetRange.tooltip: Closer than this the mob counts as having seen the player. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.sceneMaxLines: Scene between mobs: up to %s lines
mobtalk.tune.sceneMaxLines.tooltip: How many lines mobs may exchange in one scene (from 2).
mobtalk.tune.villageChatterSeconds.toolt: At most one villager talk per village in this time. Seconds.
mobtalk.tune.villageChatterRange.tooltip: Villagers only start a talk while you are closer than this. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.noticeMinutes: One announcement per village every %s min
mobtalk.tune.noticeMinutes.tooltip: At most one chat announcement per village in this time. Minutes.
mobtalk.tune.noticeWorkPercent.tooltip: Share of "come over, I have work" among announcements. Percent.
mobtalk.tune.noticeRange.tooltip: A villager writes only while you are closer than this or in its village. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.villageExilePoints.tooltip: Sum of residents' relationships and rumours at which the village exiles you: no trade, the golem watches.
mobtalk.tune.villageSuspectPoints.toolti: Below this you are a suspect: villagers warn you, the golem keeps an eye on you.
mobtalk.tune.villageFriendPoints.tooltip: From these points (and three acquainted villagers) you are one of the village.
mobtalk.tune.villageGuardPoints.tooltip: From these points (and five acquaintances) you are the village's guardian.
mobtalk.tune.villageElderPoints.tooltip: From these points (eight acquaintances, a village of ten) you are the village head.
mobtalk.tune.friendLeaseMinutes.tooltip: How many game minutes a mob keeps STAY, GUARD or SPARE without being asked again.
mobtalk.tune.friendLeaveRange: Gives up if you are beyond %s blocks
mobtalk.tune.friendLeaveRange.tooltip: Go further and the mob ends the request (except SPARE). Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.guardNear.tooltip: When walking back the guard comes this close. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.guardFar.tooltip: The guard stays put until the guarded one is further than this. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.guardAlert.tooltip: A hostile this close to the guarded one is attacked. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.guardChase.tooltip: A chase this far from the guarded one is given up. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.stayDrift.tooltip: How far a waiting mob may wander before returning. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.spokenOfferMinutes.tooltip: How many game minutes a row promised in words stays in the trade window.
mobtalk.tune.bargainCooldownMinutes.tool: Pause after a haggle before you can bargain with the same villager again. Game minutes.
mobtalk.info.title: Mob and village
mobtalk.settings.info.tooltip: Everything about the selected mob and its village: character, relationship, state, bonds, deals, memory, place, residents, rumours, families. Also /mobtalk info.
mobtalk.settings.nameTags.tooltip: A label above known mobs: name, state word and relationship with hearts.
mobtalk.settings.weddingCeremony.tooltip: A ring in hand makes an engagement, not a marriage. Tell your fiance in daytime to go to the wedding: the couple and the whole village walk to the bell, the officiant asks for better or for worse, you make your vow aloud, guests give wishes, then fireworks. Ask for witnesses with: be my witness. Off: married right after the ring, as before.
mobtalk.tune.weddingVowSeconds.tooltip: How long you may speak your vow while holding the talk key. Only at a wedding; ordinary talk stays at 15 seconds.
mobtalk.tune.weddingVowWaitSeconds.toolt: How long the officiant waits for your answer before asking again; after the second wait silence means yes.
mobtalk.tune.weddingGatherSeconds: Gathering at the bell: up to %s s
mobtalk.tune.weddingGatherSeconds.toolti: How long to wait for everyone to reach their places; latecomers miss the start.
mobtalk.tune.weddingGuests.tooltip: How many adult villagers come besides the couple, the officiant and the witnesses: kin first, then by how they like you. Those who dislike you stay away.
mobtalk.tune.weddingWishes.tooltip: How many guests (witnesses first) give a wish in their own voice; the rest shout Gorko in the chat.
mobtalk.tune.weddingRange.tooltip: Villagers within this many blocks of the bell come to the wedding.
mobtalk.tune.weddingScenePercent.tooltip: The share of weddings between villagers, while you are near the village, held as a scene at the bell with an officiant and wishes; the rest happen at once, as before.
mobtalk.tune.weddingAttireDays.tooltip: How many game days after the wedding the couple and witnesses keep their crowns and veil; 0 takes them off right after the feast.
mobtalk.settings.pregnancy.tooltip: The player's couple gets a baby the human way: after 'let's have a child' every night together has a chance, a special night ('I have a surprise for you', candles, flowers, a carpet, a record, a cake) a bigger one. The woman of the couple carries; term, news, cravings, a gentle birth. Off: the baby comes a game day later, as before. Same-sex couples keep the old way for now.
mobtalk.settings.familyFade.tooltip: A special night fades softly to black and ends with 'Next morning…'; a birth is a short fade for those nearby. Off: vanilla sleep only.
mobtalk.settings.humanVillagers.tooltip: Villagers look like people, as in MCA Reborn: their own skin, face, eye and hair colour, clothes by profession, children resemble their parents. It is still the vanilla villager: trading, weddings, children and sleep work as before. Turn off for the vanilla model (instantly, no reload).
mobtalk.settings.pregnancyBelly.tooltip: A separate layer over the vanilla villager model (and the player in third person): slightly round mid-term, clearly at the end. May look off with resource packs — then turn it off.
mobtalk.settings.pregnancyStatus.tooltip: A second line in the label over her: 'expecting · 3 of 5 days', on the last day 'birth soon'.
mobtalk.tune.pregnancyDays.tooltip: Game days from the special night to the birth. A new length applies from the next conception.
mobtalk.tune.conceptionChance.tooltip: The chance of a baby for an ordinary night together, once the couple decided to have one.
mobtalk.tune.specialNightChanceMin.toolt: The chance for a special night in a bare home.
mobtalk.tune.specialNightChanceMax.toolt: The chance for a special night with everything ready: candles, flowers, a carpet, a record, a cake and nobody else around.
mobtalk.tune.specialNightHearts.tooltip: Hearts the morning after a special night adds.
mobtalk.tune.specialNightQuietSeconds.to: The special night is not skipped while you whisper with your partner; this much silence and morning comes.
mobtalk.tune.sttTimeoutSeconds.tooltip: How long the server waits for OpenRouter STT before asking the fallback model once.
mobtalk.test.server: The recording went to the server, waiting for the text…
mobtalk.tune.budgetPlayerPerMinute.toolt: How many model requests one player may make in a minute. 0 means no limit.
mobtalk.tune.budgetPlayerDailyUsd.toolti: Dollars one player may spend a day (server clock) on the model, speech and transcription. 0 means no limit.
mobtalk.tune.budgetServerPerMinute.toolt: How many model requests all players together may make in a minute. 0 means no limit.
mobtalk.tune.budgetServerDailyUsd.toolti: Dollars the whole server may spend a day. 0 means no limit.
mobtalk.tune.budgetStreamerMultiplier.to: How many times larger the streamer's limits are than a player's. The admin has none.
mobtalk.tune.maxConcurrentDialogues.tool: How many answers the server writes at once for all players. At most two per player.
mobtalk.settings.serverLocked: Server setting: the admin changes it
mobtalk.settings.serverAdmin: You are the admin: server settings go to the server
mobtalk.settings.villageDefense.tooltip: The village raises an alarm at monsters and at a player who strikes its people: the bell rings, villagers hide, the golem fights. The golem is sturdier, heals out of combat and the smith mends it with iron.
mobtalk.settings.villageNoSpawn.tooltip: No monsters spawn inside a village that has a golem. Raids and monsters coming from outside are not affected.
mobtalk.settings.alarmAgainstPlayers.too: A blow at a villager or the golem, or a hated or exiled player in the village, raises the alarm against that player: the golem attacks at once without warning, villagers hide and refuse trade.
mobtalk.settings.alarmChat.tooltip: Players near the village and those the village knows see the alarm and the all-clear in the chat.
mobtalk.settings.alarmSound.tooltip: The bell rings at any alarm, not only in an attack, and players of the village far from the bell hear the alarm bell too.
mobtalk.settings.villageNoConversion.too: A villager killed by a zombie dies instead of becoming a zombie villager. Guards and archers are never turned, whatever this says.
mobtalk.tune.defenseZoneMargin.tooltip: How many blocks around the village's buildings still count as the village: no monster spawns there and villagers notice monsters there.
mobtalk.tune.alarmMonsterRange.tooltip: How close to a villager or golem a monster must come to raise the alarm. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.alarmAttackThreats.tooltip: This many monsters at once is an attack: the bell rings, villagers hide. Fewer is a threat: the golem deals with it.
mobtalk.tune.alarmClearSeconds.tooltip: The alarm ends once nothing has been seen for this many seconds.
mobtalk.tune.alarmPlayerClearMinutes.too: How many minutes a player must stay away from the village for the alarm against them to drop. Death and /mobtalk village forgive drop it too.
mobtalk.tune.alarmPlayerRange.tooltip: How far from the village's edge a player counts as gone. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.alarmNoticeRange.tooltip: Players closer than this to the village see the alarm in the chat. Those the village counts as its own see it from anywhere. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.golemHealthPercent.tooltip: A village golem's health in percent of vanilla 100. A golem the player built is unchanged.
mobtalk.tune.golemRegenPerMinute.tooltip: Health a golem regains per minute out of combat. 0: it does not heal by itself.
mobtalk.tune.golemRepairHealth.tooltip: A smith (weaponsmith, armorer, toolsmith) walks to a wounded golem and mends it with iron by this much. 0: no mending.
mobtalk.defense.raised.attack: [%s] Alarm! The village is under attack: %s
mobtalk.defense.raised.you: The village %s raised the alarm against you: %s. Leave while you can.
mobtalk.defense.released: The village %s no longer holds the alarm against you.
mobtalk.defense.noTrade: No time to trade: the village is on alarm
mobtalk.defense.shout.player.0: %s, what are you doing?! Golem, get him!
mobtalk.defense.shout.player.1: Stop %s! He struck one of us!
mobtalk.defense.shout.player.2: %s is the village's enemy! Everyone inside!
mobtalk.defense.shout.clear.0: All clear! You can come out.
mobtalk.settings.villageTowers.tooltip: A village builds watchtowers at its edge over a game day, and an archer comes to each tower's post. Archers shoot monsters and the player the alarm is against, without warning.
mobtalk.tune.towerResidents.tooltip: How many villagers a village needs for each tower. Fewer than this: no towers.
mobtalk.tune.towerMax.tooltip: A village builds no more than this. 0: none at all.
mobtalk.tune.towerBuildMinutes.tooltip: How many real minutes a village takes to put up a tower, block by block. 20 minutes is a game day.
mobtalk.tune.archerRange.tooltip: How far an archer notices monsters (and raises the alarm) and how far it shoots. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.archerShotTenths: A shot every: %s tenths of a second
mobtalk.tune.archerShotTenths.tooltip: How often an archer looses an arrow, in tenths of a second: 20 is every 2 seconds. Archers never run out of arrows, and theirs cannot be picked up.
mobtalk.tune.archerReplaceMinutes.toolti: When a tower's post stays empty this many real minutes (the archer died or left), a new archer comes to the village.
mobtalk.defense.tower.started: [%s] The village started building a watchtower (%s)
mobtalk.defense.tower.done: [%s] The watchtower is built; at the posts now: %s
mobtalk.defense.archer.arrived: [%s] A new archer, %s, took the tower's post
mobtalk.settings.villageGuards.tooltip: A village keeps guards with sword and shield: it puts up guard stands by the bell and at its edge, and a guard comes to each. By day they hold their posts, at night half of them walk the round, in an alarm all of them fight the monsters and the player the alarm is against, at once.
mobtalk.tune.watchResidents.tooltip: How many grown villagers there are to one guard.
mobtalk.tune.watchMin.tooltip: Even a small village has this many guards.
mobtalk.tune.watchMax.tooltip: A village puts up no more guard stands than this. 0: no guards.
mobtalk.tune.watchHealth.tooltip: A plain villager has 20. A guard also wears an iron helmet and chestplate, and its shield turns half the arrows.
mobtalk.tune.watchDamage.tooltip: Damage of one sword blow, once a second. A zombie has 20 health.
mobtalk.tune.watchSight.tooltip: How far a guard sees a monster or the player the alarm is against and goes for it. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.watchReplaceMinutes.tooltip: When a stand stays empty this many real minutes (the guard died or left), a new guard comes.
mobtalk.defense.guard.arrived: [%s] A new guard in the village: %s
mobtalk.settings.divineTidings.tooltip: Divine block punishments, miracles and omens become village news: villagers blame the sinner by name, standing drops, prices rise; the righteous are thanked.
mobtalk.settings.divinePanic.tooltip: Alarm bell, villagers run home and shy away from the sinner, short shouts in chat, the priest prays, the golem steps in.
mobtalk.settings.divineMayExile.tooltip: Off: the god's wrath alone lowers a player to "suspect" at most; only the bell assembly can exile.
mobtalk.settings.divineMourners: Family of a curse victim blames the sinner
mobtalk.settings.divineMourners.tooltip: If a villager dies during a punishment, the relatives turn hard against the one whose sins brought it.
mobtalk.tune.divineStrength.tooltip: Multiplier for how much sufferers and witnesses resent the sinner and favour the righteous. 100 is the idea table.
mobtalk.tune.divineDailyCap: Standing lost per day at most %s
mobtalk.tune.divineDailyCap.tooltip: How many relationship points a player can lose to divine punishments in one village per game day.
mobtalk.tune.divineSurcharge.tooltip: Bad gossip about the sinner among villagers near the punishment (vanilla gossip points): higher prices, fades with time. 0 disables.
mobtalk.tune.divineBlessDiscount.tooltip: Good gossip about the righteous after a miracle (vanilla gossip points): lower prices. 0 disables.
mobtalk.tune.divineAssemblyCurses.toolti: Punishments for one player in one village per game day that call the assembly: repent before sunset or be exiled. 0 disables.
mobtalk.tune.divinePersonalRadius.toolti: Villages this close to the sinner learn of a personal punishment. Blocks.
mobtalk.divine.assembly: The elder of "%s" called the village to the bell: %s must repent before sunset or be exiled.
mobtalk.divine.exiled: The assembly of "%s" exiled %s: no penance before sunset.
mobtalk.settings.moments.hint: The server marks bright moments by itself: wrath, bosses, weddings, deaths, scenes with villagers. The list with timecodes is in the «Moments» tab of the web admin and in /clip export. OBS is optional: it gives exact timecodes from the start of the recording, chapters in the file and saved replays.
mobtalk.settings.moments.obs.tooltip: Connect to OBS on this computer over obs-websocket (OBS 28+: Tools → WebSocket Server Settings → Enable). The server learns when the stream and the recording run and counts timecodes from their start.
mobtalk.settings.moments.check.tooltip: Redraw the OBS connection status line.
mobtalk.settings.moments.address.tooltip: Host and port of the OBS WebSocket server, usually 127.0.0.1:4455.
mobtalk.settings.moments.chapters.toolti: Every moment becomes a chapter in the recording file. Needs OBS 30.2+ and the Hybrid MP4 format; other formats just skip chapters.
mobtalk.settings.moments.replay.tooltip: A strong moment saves the OBS replay buffer (start it in OBS). The file path appears on the moment in the admin.
mobtalk.settings.moments.replayWeight.to: Which moments save a replay: ★ — any, ★★★ — only the brightest.
mobtalk.settings.moments.replayDelay.too: Seconds to wait after the moment so the replay holds what came right after it.
mobtalk.settings.moments.scope.tooltip: Mine — chapters and replays of my moments and world events only. All — every player's moments (for an operator recording everyone).
mobtalk.settings.moments.notice.tooltip: What to show when I mark a moment with the key or /clip.
mobtalk.settings.key.placeholder.obs: Paste the password from the OBS WebSocket settings
mobtalk.settings.key.remove.tooltip.obs: Removes the password saved from the menu or in config/mobtalk-obs-password.txt. The OBS_WEBSOCKET_PASSWORD variable stays.
mobtalk.settings.key.environment.obs: Using OBS_WEBSOCKET_PASSWORD (%s) — the variable wins over the menu.
mobtalk.settings.key.none.obs: No password. If OBS has authentication on, paste the password below.
mobtalk.settings.overlayEnabled.tooltip: The game serves a page on 127.0.0.1: add it to OBS as a Browser source. Subtitles, god, players' grace, punishments and events.
mobtalk.settings.overlayShowMe.tooltip: Off: you are left out of the streamer's grace table, and their verdicts drop your name and reasons.
mobtalk.settings.overlayPort.tooltip: Port on this computer (1024–65535), 8790 by default. Applies after Save.
mobtalk.settings.overlayCopy.tooltip: Copy the page address. In OBS: Sources → + → Browser, paste it, 1920×1080.
mobtalk.settings.overlayOpen.tooltip: Open the overlay in a browser to see how it looks.
mobtalk.settings.overlayTest.tooltip: 30 seconds of made-up subtitles, god, punishments and a banner, with no model or voice.
mobtalk.settings.overlayTest.done: Test data on the overlay for 30 seconds
mobtalk.settings.overlaySubtitles.toolti: Villagers' and god's lines at the bottom, in time with the voice.
mobtalk.settings.overlayGod.tooltip: God's mood and the last verdict with its reasons.
mobtalk.settings.overlayMercy.tooltip: Online players: grace candles, sins, punishment.
mobtalk.settings.overlayNow.tooltip: The running punishment with a timer, boss health bar, wedding, court, admin banner.
mobtalk.settings.overlayHeard.tooltip: A grey line above the villager's answer with what was said to them.
mobtalk.settings.overlayChatter.tooltip: Show village chatter, witnesses and villagers calling out, not only answers.
mobtalk.settings.overlayStyle.tooltip: Parrot Cages like the mod menus; parchment with Old Slavonic frames; minimal dark plates.
mobtalk.settings.overlayLayout.tooltip: Card is one small panel: god's mood, your mercy, the main curse or boss and the last line. Full screen shows every widget. /overlay/card and /overlay/full pick the layout themselves.
mobtalk.settings.overlayReduceMotion.too: No shaking, rays or typing: everything simply appears.
mobtalk.tune.overlayHoldSeconds.tooltip: How many seconds a line stays on screen after the voice ends.
mobtalk.tune.overlayScale.tooltip: Size of every widget on the page; also via the address, ?scale=1.25.
mobtalk.settings.villageHeavy.tooltip: Some of the guard are heavy warriors: full diamond armour and a diamond axe, slower but tougher and hitting harder.
mobtalk.settings.villageCavalry.tooltip: Some of the guard are horsemen: leather armour, a sword, a village horse under the saddle. They reach a foe first.
mobtalk.tune.towerLargeResidents.tooltip: A village with this many grown residents or more builds large 7×7 towers: two archers and two crossbowmen on the platform. 0 — small ones only.
mobtalk.tune.crossbowRange.tooltip: How far a crossbowman on a large tower shoots. Hits harder than an archer. Blocks.
mobtalk.tune.crossbowShotTenths: A bolt every: %s tenths of a second
mobtalk.tune.crossbowShotTenths.tooltip: How often a crossbowman shoots, in tenths of a second. Less often than an archer, but harder.
mobtalk.tune.heavyHealth.tooltip: The health of a heavy warrior in diamond armour.
mobtalk.tune.heavyDamage.tooltip: The damage of a heavy warrior's blow. It strikes less often than a guard.
mobtalk.defense.soldier.arrived: [%s] A new fighter in the village — %s %s
mobtalk.tune.cityPerVillages.tooltip: Cities with panel blocks, an administration and a hospital take the place of some villages. 0: no cities. Applies after the world is reloaded, in new land only.
mobtalk.settings.cities.tooltip: Big cities in a biome of their own: an avenue, streets, blocks of panel houses with real flats. On, they replace the old cities that took a village's place. Applies after the world is reloaded, in new land only.
mobtalk.tune.citySpacing.tooltip: The world is cut into squares of this size, at most one city in a square. Smaller: more cities.
mobtalk.tune.cityChance.tooltip: The chance a square of the grid holds a city. No city stands over an ocean, a river or in the mountains.
mobtalk.tune.cityRadius.tooltip: Half the city's side: its streets and houses stand on level ground this far from the centre.
mobtalk.tune.cityBiomeRadius.tooltip: The City biome around the built-up area: no trees, the ground eases from the city back to the wild, the exit roads run here.

mobtalk.lift.title: Lift
mobtalk.lift.dispatcher: Dispatcher: “Listening… wait, the mechanic is on his way”
mobtalk.tune.liftSpeedTenths: Lift speed: %s tenths of a block per second
mobtalk.tune.liftSpeedTenths.tooltip: 1 block = 1 m. A real Soviet lift runs at 1 m/s, a 16-storey one at 1.4 m/s.
mobtalk.tune.liftDoorSeconds.tooltip: How long the doors stay open when nobody is in the doorway.
mobtalk.tune.liftVillagerChance.tooltip: Chance a minute that a villager by the lift doors calls it and rides to their own or a random floor. 0: stairs only.
mobtalk.furniture.chute: Rubbish chute: hold something you don't need and drop it in
mobtalk.furniture.notice.0: “No hot water from 1 to 14 July. Housing office”
mobtalk.furniture.notice.1: “Residents' meeting Thursday 7 pm by entrance two”
mobtalk.furniture.notice.2: “Lost dog, ginger, answers to Sharik. Flat 34”
mobtalk.furniture.notice.3: “Please do not smoke on the stairs!”
mobtalk.furniture.notice.4: “Clean-up day on Saturday. The janitor hands out rakes”
mobtalk.furniture.notice.6: “Meter checks. Don't open the door to strangers!”
mobtalk.furniture.notice.7: “Whoever took the sled from under the stairs — bring it back!”
